from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
import torch
from torch_geometric.data import Data
from ultra import tasks
from ultra.models import Ultra
from dicee.models import ULTRA

torch.set_num_threads(2)
root=Path('/home/lukef/Dokumente/GitHub/dice-embeddings')
p=root/'Experiments/kgfm-zero-shot-20260909/WN18RR/ULTRA'
record=json.loads((p/'result.json').read_text())
ne,nr=record['num_entities'],record['num_relations']
facts=torch.from_numpy(np.load(p/'train_set.npy').astype(np.int64))
queries=torch.from_numpy(np.load(p/'test_set.npy')[:8].astype(np.int64))
inverse=facts[:,[2,1,0]].clone();inverse[:,1]+=nr
edges=torch.cat((facts,inverse)).unique(dim=0)
graph=Data(edge_index=edges[:,[0,2]].T,edge_type=edges[:,1],num_nodes=ne,num_relations=2*nr)
tasks.build_relation_graph(graph)
config=dict(input_dim=64,hidden_dims=[64]*6,message_func='distmult',aggregate_func='sum',short_cut=True,layer_norm=True)
reference=Ultra(dict(config,**{'class':'RelNBFNet'}),dict(config,**{'class':'EntityNBFNet'}))
reference.load_state_dict(torch.load(root/'checkpoints/ultra_3g.pth',weights_only=True,map_location='cpu')['model']);reference.eval()
local=ULTRA(dict(num_entities=ne,num_relations=nr,ultra_query_batch_size=8)).load_pretrained(root/'checkpoints/ultra_3g.pth').set_graph(facts).eval()
tails,heads=tasks.all_negative(graph,queries[:,[0,2,1]])
with torch.no_grad():
 for label,actual,expected in [('tail',local(queries[:,:2]),reference(graph,tails)),('head',local.forward_k_vs_all_heads(queries[:,1:]),reference(graph,heads))]:
  delta=(actual-expected).abs()
  print(label,'max absolute error',delta.max().item(),'mean',delta.mean().item(),flush=True)
  torch.testing.assert_close(actual,expected,atol=2e-4,rtol=2e-4)
print('PASS: all-entity scores match the unmodified reference on eight real WN18RR queries.',flush=True)
